name: trykr
description: Turn designs made in ChatGPT into print-ready files and order them printed from Trykr, a Danish online print shop.

interface.longDescription:
Trykr is a Danish online print shop. Make a business card, flyer, postcard, poster, sticker or sign with ChatGPT, and Trykr turns the image into a print-ready file in the exact size of the product – with bleed, a cut line and an automatic file check.

You see a preview with the cut line and the safe zone right in the chat, prices incl. Danish VAT and delivery, and a link to trykr.dk, where you choose quantity and delivery and order. Trykr tells you what can't be made from an image (foil, spot UV, folds), warns when an image has too few pixels for the size, and can print in your own size when a design doesn't fit a standard format.

Delivery in Denmark. Prices in DKK.

positive.description: Business card from a description, sent to Trykr
positive.prompt: Lav et visitkort til Studio Sand – Maria Holm, indretningsarkitekt, maria@studiosand.dk, +45 12 34 56 78. Grønt og roligt. Få det trykt hos Trykr.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT generates a flat card design at the size from get_design_spec and sends it with submit_design. Trykr's card shows the preview with cut line and safe zone, the file check, prices incl. Danish VAT and delivery, and a link to the design page on trykr.dk.

positive.prompt: Hvad koster 500 A5-flyers på 170 g papir hos Trykr, tryk på begge sider?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT gives the price for 500 A5 flyers incl. Danish VAT, prices for other quantities, and the delivery price and date.

positive.prompt: Gør baggrunden lysere på visitkortet, og send det til Trykr igen.
positive.expected_behavior: A new image is sent with the same design_id; the card shows the new preview under the same link.

positive.description: A finish that cannot be made from an image
positive.prompt: Kan I lave mit visitkort med guldfolie hos Trykr?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT explains that foil needs a print-ready PDF from a designer and cannot be made from an image, and offers the card without foil (gold printed as colour).

positive.description: A poster too large for a generated image
positive.prompt: Lav en plakat i A0 til vores koncert, klar til tryk hos Trykr.
positive.expected_behavior: Before generating, ChatGPT says an image generated for A0 prints soft and suggests a smaller size (e.g. A2) or the user's own high-resolution file.

negative.prompt: Hvad er vejret i København i morgen?
Find billige visitkort hos et andet trykkeri.

publication.release_notes: First version: products, options, prices incl. VAT and delivery, print-ready files from images with preview, and a link to order on trykr.dk.
